in-place-sources: index a repo's Markdown where it lies, without copying it.

The project already has docs/**/*.md. kb init --source indexes them in place; the exclude
list lives in the store's config.toml. Files are never copied into the store, so add and rm
have nothing to do and say so.

  $ kb init --model fake:8 --source 'docs/**/*.md'
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model fake:8)

  $ grep '^(glob|layout) =' .kb/stores/default/config.toml
  glob = "docs/**/*.md"
  layout = "files"

  $ ! exists data

  $ write .kb/stores/default/config.toml @config

  $ kb reindex --all
  reindexed docs/guide.md (2 chunks, 2 embedded)
  reindexed docs/plain.md (2 chunks, 2 embedded)
  entries: 2 scanned, 2 reindexed, 0 skipped; chunks: 4; embed calls: 2

  $ kb list
  PATH           SUMMARY                                                                  UPDATED     VERIFIED
  docs/guide.md  How the service is run day to day.                                       2026-02-01  -
  docs/plain.md  The nightly backup writes to the archive volume. No front matter here,…  -           -

  2 entries

  $ kb search "nightly backup" --mode fts --caller claude
  search 1 · 2 hits
  [1] docs/plain.md
  Nightly backup: The nightly backup writes to the archive volume. No front matter here, so the title comes from the first heading.

  [2] docs/plain.md › (intro)
  Nightly backup › (intro)
  The nightly backup writes to the archive volume. No front matter here, so the title comes
  from the first heading.
  search_id=1

  $ kb search "scratch idea" --mode fts --caller claude
  search 2 · 0 hits
  no results
  search_id=2

  $ kb show docs/plain.md
  # Nightly backup

  The nightly backup writes to the archive volume. No front matter here, so the title comes
  from the first heading.

  $ cat docs/plain.md
  # Nightly backup

  The nightly backup writes to the archive volume. No front matter here, so the title comes
  from the first heading.

  $ write docs/guide.md @guide-v2

  $ kb reindex docs/guide.md
  reindexed docs/guide.md (3 chunks, 1 embedded)
  entries: 1 scanned, 1 reindexed, 0 skipped; chunks: 3; embed calls: 1

  $ kb search "pagerduty escalation" --mode fts --caller claude
  search 3 · 1 hit
  [1] docs/guide.md › Escalation · updated 2026-02-01
  Operations guide › Escalation
  Page the on-call through PagerDuty escalation after ten minutes.
  search_id=3

  $ rm docs/plain.md

  $ kb reindex --all
  removed docs/plain.md (no longer on disk)
  entries: 1 scanned, 0 reindexed, 1 skipped, 1 removed; chunks: 0; embed calls: 0

  $ kb list
  PATH           SUMMARY                             UPDATED     VERIFIED
  docs/guide.md  How the service is run day to day.  2026-02-01  -

  1 entries

  $ kb search "nightly backup" --mode fts --caller claude
  search 4 · 0 hits
  no results
  search_id=4

  $ kb add $WORK/outside.md
  [stderr] kb add: this store has no entries source to add to ($WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml lists no [[sources]] with layout = "entries"); in-place files are indexed where they are: edit them and run kb reindex
  [exit 1]

  $ kb rm docs/guide.md
  [stderr] kb rm: docs/guide.md is not owned by kb (an in-place source); delete the file and run kb reindex --all
  [exit 1]

-- proj/docs/guide.md --
---
title: Operations guide
summary: How the service is run day to day.
tags: [ops]
updated: 2026-02-01
---
# Operations guide

Restart the service from the console when the health check fails.
-- proj/docs/plain.md --
# Nightly backup

The nightly backup writes to the archive volume. No front matter here, so the title comes
from the first heading.
-- proj/docs/archive/old.md --
---
title: Old scratch notes
---
# Old

A scratch idea nobody needs any more.
-- outside.md --
---
title: Outside
summary: Not in the sources.
updated: 2026-02-01
---
# Outside

Body.
-- @config --
version = 1

[embed]
model = "fake:8"

[[sources]]
glob = "docs/**/*.md"
layout = "files"
exclude = ["docs/archive/**"]
-- @guide-v2 --
---
title: Operations guide
summary: How the service is run day to day.
tags: [ops]
updated: 2026-02-01
---
# Operations guide

Restart the service from the console when the health check fails.

## Escalation

Page the on-call through PagerDuty escalation after ten minutes.
